title: ZAG Digital Atlas
abstract: Structures and sites in Slovenia where the work of ZAG, the Slovenian National Building and Civil Engineering Institute, is documented in published sources. Each value carries the link of the source it was read from.
lineage: Records compiled from ZAG publications, reference lists and owner, operator and research sources, each linked per value.
Alignments and many positions matched to OpenStreetMap ways.
Building outlines and heights from the GURS real estate cadastre.
Roof surfaces from the GURS laser scanning.

extent.note: The Karavanke tunnels run into Austria.

referenceSystem.national: D96/TM, EPSG:3794, fields e_d96tm and n_d96tm in metres

positionalAccuracy.matched: matched to the mapped structure in OpenStreetMap
positionalAccuracy.site: centre of the site, not the object

attribution.openstreetmap: Alignments and matched positions contain information from OpenStreetMap, made available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
attribution.gurs: Cadastre and laser scanning values: Geodetska uprava Republike Slovenije (GURS), CC BY 4.0
attribution.sources: Every specification carries the link of the source it was read from. Each source keeps its own licence.

maintenance: Updated when sources change; news refreshed several times an hour.
